name: content-creator
description: One-stop AI content creation platform: generate, edit, and publish AI videos.

scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn content_creator_api.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.api:typecheck: cd apps/api && uv run mypy content_creator_api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm api:typecheck
